metadata.title: INSANE Odia SEA FOOD Feast at Chilika Dhaba | Best Juicy Crab in Odisha
metadata.description:
Another gem hidden in the beautiful state of Odisha, the Chilika Lake is a brackish water lagoon, spread over Puri, Khurda and Ganjam districts of Odisha. Our search for yummy meals brought us to this gorgeous location and right in front of the lake we found Seafood Heaven at the Chilika Dhaba.

The Chilika Dhaba is known for serving a wide variety of Seafood, from fish to crabs, they give you the options of fried seafoods or curries. Enjoy perfectly spiced and juicy Crabs, delicious Prawn Curry and Fish fried in Mustard Oil. You can scoop up these lovely dishes with plain, boiled rice that is cooked on a huge scale. If you happen to be a vegetarian, fret not! They even serve a number of unique vegetarian dishes - Mushroom, Paneer and Cauliflower curries that are perfect to have with some rice.

Experience Chilika Lake and the delectable dishes at Chilika Dhaba in Odisha. Join us on our next food adventure.

#chilikadhaba #WalkwithDelhiFoodWalks

About the host - Anubhav Sapra :

Anubhav Sapra is an avid foodie! He is a Founder but proudly calls himself a Foodie-in-chief at Delhi Food Walks. He is also a street-food and Indian regional cuisine connoisseur and loves to write about street-food.

Please subscribe to our YouTube channel to keep our Indian street food explorations video in your feed! Thank you for watching!
